invention.ref: Adolf Fick in Zurich and Eugène Kalt in Paris independently fabricate the first wearable blown-glass scleral contact lenses
invention.ref_zh: 阿道夫·菲克在苏黎世与欧仁·卡尔特在巴黎分别吹制出贴合巩膜的首批玻璃隐形眼镜

patent.ref: Kevin Tuohy files US patent (US2510438A) for corneal plastic (PMMA) contact lenses in California
patent.ref_zh: 凯文·托希在加利福尼亚取得首款仅覆盖角膜的塑料（PMMA）隐形眼镜专利

mass_production.ref: Otto Wichterle invents soft hydrogel (pHEMA) lenses in Prague using a homemade centrifuge apparatus
mass_production.ref_zh: 捷克化学家奥托·威特勒在布拉格利用自制旋铸机发明水凝胶（pHEMA）软性隐形眼镜

popularization.ref: Bausch & Lomb gains FDA approval and launches the SofLens, turning soft contact lenses into a global consumer product
popularization.ref_zh: 博士伦（Bausch & Lomb）推出首款获 FDA 批准的软性隐形眼镜 SofLens，掀起全球普及热潮

locations.place_label_zh: 瑞士苏黎世（菲克制作首副矫正视力的玻璃隐形眼镜）
locations.place_label_en: Zurich, Switzerland (Adolf Fick fits first corrective glass contact lenses)

locations.place_label_zh: 捷克布拉格（威特勒发明水凝胶软性隐形眼镜）
locations.place_label_en: Prague, Czech Republic (Otto Wichterle invents soft hydrogel lenses)

locations.place_label_zh: 美国纽约州罗切斯特（博士伦量产 SofLens 软镜）
locations.place_label_en: Rochester, New York, USA (Bausch & Lomb commercializes SofLens)

summary_zh: 1888 年菲克与卡尔特首创玻璃巩膜接触镜；1961 年威特勒在布拉格发明透水亲水的水凝胶软镜，摆脱了外置镜框对人类面部视觉矫正的束缚。
summary_en: Pioneered in 1888 with blown-glass scleral lenses and revolutionized in 1961 by Otto Wichterle's soft hydrogel material, contact lenses freed millions from external spectacle frames.
